ITEM.PTXT: When the brake pads wear and the clearance between the pads and rotor exceeds a certain value, the hydraulic pressure from pedal operation causes the sleeve nut to advance while rotating, adjusting the clearance. In addition, the piston and sleeve nut are engaged at the clutch surface; when the hydraulic pressure from pedal operation reaches a certain value, the sleeve nut stops rotating and adjustment stops, preventing over-adjustment and keeping the clearance between the pads and rotor appropriate.
